title: Structural versus Allocative Inefficiency Across Organizational Settings
abstract: arXiv:2609.23744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations invest heavily in internal mechanisms such as incentive systems, governance structures, performance measurement, analytics, and repeated reorganizations. Yet realized performance gains are often weak or short-lived, particularly in large and mature organizations. Standard explanations emphasize allocative inefficiency arising from incentive misalignment, information problems, or bounded rationality. While relevant, these explanations struggle to account for environments in which effort is high, optimization capabilities are sophisticated, and aggregate performance remains far below apparent potential. This paper develops a theory of structural inefficiency inside organizations. The central mechanism is the presence of internal externalities: unpriced cross-effects of organizational mechanisms acting simultaneously on multiple performance objectives. translated_title: 组织情境中的结构性低效率与配置性低效率
translated_abstract: 组织在内部机制上投入巨大，例如激励制度、治理结构、绩效测量、分析工具以及反复的组织重组。然而，实际取得的绩效提升往往微弱或短暂，尤其是在大型和成熟组织中。标准的解释强调由激励错位、信息问题或有限理性所导致的配置性低效率。尽管这些解释有其合理性，但它们难以解释那些努力程度很高、优化能力成熟先进、而总体绩效却仍远低于表面潜力的情境。本文提出了一种关于组织内部结构性低效率的理论。其核心机制是内部外部性的存在：组织机制在同时作用于多个绩效目标时产生的未被定价的交叉效应。当这类效应的正负符号相互混合时，组织努力会被部分（抵消）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了组织“结构性低效率”理论，指出组织机制同时作用于多个绩效目标时产生的未定价交叉效应（内部外部性）会使组织努力被部分抵消，从而解释了为何在努力充足、优化能力先进的组织中绩效仍远低于潜力，以此区别于传统的激励错位等配置性低效率解释。
